changes.title: In Dropping Reflecting Pool Case, Pirro Draws Trump’s Wrath
changes.summary: Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney in Washington, blamed shoddy construction, contradicting President Trump’s pet theory. Mr. Trump said he disagreed “100%” with her.

changes.title: Trump Blasts Jeanine Pirro’s Move to Drop Reflecting Pool Charges
changes.summary: President Donald Trump is criticizing his handpicked choice for U.S. attorney in D.C., Jeanine Pirro, for dropping charges against the former Olympian accused of vandalizing the reflecting pool. Meanwhile, the president said he will continue to push for an “anti-weaponization fund” if the senate does not confirm Todd B.

changes.title: Discovered by Atlas

changes.title: Trump rebukes Jeanine Pirro over decision to drop Reflecting Pool vandalism case
changes.summary: President Donald Trump criticized longtime ally Jeanine Pirro Saturday after she agreed to drop a case against a former Olympic canoeist who was accused of vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.
